title: HyQuant: Hybrid-Precision Quantization for LLM Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.27875v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Quantization has been widely adopted in LLM training and inference to reduce cost and improve efficiency. However, low-bit quantization of the \emph{attention} module often introduces large errors at very low bit-widths, causing performance degradation. Existing methods mainly rely on smoothing techniques to handle outliers, while we propose a hybrid quantization design to better balance accuracy and efficiency. Specifically, we propose \textbf{HyQuant}, an efficient hybrid quantization framework for LLM attention. HyQuant quantizes most attention states into low-bit formats while retaining a small set of vertical-line tokens and local-window states in high precision. These accuracy-critical regions are selected using lightweight vertical-line-aware attention-pattern signals, reducing quantization error with limited overhead. translated_title: HyQuant：面向大语言模型注意力机制的混合精度量化
translated_abstract: 量化已被广泛用于大语言模型（LLM）的训练与推理，以降低成本并提升效率。然而，注意力模块的低比特量化在极低比特宽度下往往会引入较大误差，导致性能下降。现有方法主要依赖平滑技术来处理离群值，而我们提出了一种混合量化设计，以更好地平衡精度与效率。具体而言，我们提出了 HyQuant，一个面向大语言模型注意力的高效混合量化框架。HyQuant 将大部分注意力状态量化为低比特格式，同时以高精度保留少量的竖线型（vertical-line）token 和局部窗口状态。这些对精度至关重要的区域通过轻量级的竖线感知注意力模式信号来选取，从而以有限的开销降低量化误差。在 Prefill 阶段，HyQuant 采用一种混合精度量化的注意力算子，保留竖线型……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: HyQuant 提出了一种面向大语言模型注意力的混合精度量化框架，通过轻量的注意力模式信号识别并高精度保留少量关键 token 和局部窗口状态，将其余状态量化为低比特，以极小开销显著降低量化误差并平衡精度与效率。
en_tdlr: HyQuant is a hybrid-precision quantization framework for LLM attention that quantizes most attention states to low bits while using lightweight attention-pattern signals to retain a small set of accuracy-critical tokens and local-window states in high precision, reducing quantization error with minimal overhead.
